value.title: How to bridge tokens using the Uniswap web app

steps.action: Open the web app and connect your wallet.
steps.expected: Wallet is connected to the Uniswap web app.

steps.action: Select the token you want to bridge.
steps.expected: The chosen token is set as the token to bridge.

steps.action: Select the network you want to bridge to.
Enter the amount you would like to bridge, or select the “Max” option.
steps.expected: The amount is filled in; “Max” automatically inputs the total amount of the token available in your wallet.
A review of the bridge is shown with an “Approve and swap” option.
Your wallet prompts you to approve Uniswap to access your tokens.

steps.action: Using your wallet, approve Uniswap to access your tokens. This step requires a network cost.
In your wallet, confirm the bridge. This step requires a network cost.
steps.expected: Congratulations! You have bridged tokens to a different network. Received tokens appear in your wallet and swap details are viewable in the portfolio activity section.
